full_details: You sat at her table before church, and the loaf was not put to the notch. She had the night to prepare it. The girl should have minded her mother, and the mother the girl. The friar was a meddler, the nurse wanted whipping, and the old men were fools. She would not have had the prince's office for a pension. She had something in her eye at the end, and that was all she would say of the end. The two houses were friends for the length of a speech. Alse asked whether they were boys, even the one that dies. You told her he is fifteen, lodges in Aldermanbury, and ate two pies after. She will not go again. In the afternoon Kettleby called from Somerset House. Sir Edward Hoby wants the company at Canon Row on Tuesday, after supper, and he wants the king whole. You were not told the guest. You sent the errand-boy to Heminges with four lines and no name. At evening Bryan stood on the third step. You counted bodies, paper, candles and the tide. You wrote the work on your tables. You did not write a reason.
one_sentence: Before church she gave you the lovers' verdict and said she would not go again, and in the afternoon a gentleman's parlour asked you for the king whole.
title: She refused a second play, and a parlour asked for the king
